sql:
SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1 AND f.`2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Status` = 1;

SELECT s.School, s.Magnet
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
WHERE st.NumTstTakr > 500 AND (s.Magnet = 1 OR s.MagnetProgram IS NOT NULL);

SELECT s.School, s.Magnet, s.EILName, s.GSoffered
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
WHERE st.NumTstTakr > 500 AND (s.Magnet = 1 OR s.EILName LIKE '%Magnet%' OR s.GSoffered LIKE '%Magnet%');

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE sa.NumTstTakr > 500 AND (s.Magnet = 1 OR s.MagnetProgram IS NOT NULL);

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Magnet
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN 
    satscores sa ON s.School = sa.sname
WHERE 
    f.`2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Status` = 1
    AND sa.NumTstTakr > 500
    AND (s.Magnet = 1 OR s.GSoffered LIKE '%Magnet%');

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.School = sa.sname
WHERE s.Magnet = 1 AND sa.NumTstTakr > 500;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.AvgScrMath >= 500 AND s.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.AvgScrMath >= 500 AND s.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
WHERE st.AvgScrMath >= 500 AND s.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.School_Code
WHERE s.Magnet = 1 OR s.GSoffered LIKE '%Magnet%'
AND f.`2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Status` = 1
AND s.NumTstTakr > 500;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.School_Code
WHERE s.Magnet = 1 OR 'Magnet Program' IN (SELECT DISTINCT GSoffered FROM schools WHERE Magnet = 1)
AND s.NumTstTakr > 500;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
WHERE s.Magnet = 1 AND st.NumTstTakr > 500;

SELECT s.School 
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Status` = 1 AND s.NumTstTakr > 500 AND (s.Magnet = 1 OR s.EILName LIKE '%Magnet%');
